arrangement.notes: Sparse verses with strong hooks; sample-based arrangement employing texture beds and one-shot hits. Kanal isimleri sample parçalama tekniklerine göre organize edilmiştir.

event_markers.reason: Start of sparse verse with vocals

sample_layers.name: texture_bed
sample_layers.description: Looped atmospheric textures to provide base environment

sample_layers.name: one_shot_hits
sample_layers.description: Percussive one-shot samples triggered at key rhythmic points

sound_intent.samples: Use warm, vinyl-style samples with emphasis on texture bed loops and clean one-shot hits.
sound_intent.effects: Use subtle reverb and delay to enhance emotional mood.
sound_intent.dynamics: Sparse verses with lower dynamic range, strong and lively hooks with fuller mix.

track_roles.bass: supportive low end with sample-based basslines
track_roles.chords: texture bed loops providing harmonic support
track_roles.melody: minimal melodic content focusing on hook sections
track_roles.vocal: sparse vocal lines highlighting emotional content

designer_intent.focus: Create emotional boom bap arrangement with experimental textures, sparse verses, and strong hooks emphasizing sample slicing techniques.

presetor_intent.priority: Preserve dynamic energy transitions and sample integrity, emphasizing clear one-shot hits and textured beds.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate rhythmic foundation using sliced drum samples with dynamic hits on hooks and sparse activity during verses.

bass_generator.brief: Provide low-end support using sample-based basslines that complement the emotional mood and sparse verses.

harmony_generator.brief: Create texture beds from looped samples and minimal chord elements, focusing on emotional atmospheric support.

melody_generator.brief: Construct minimal melodic lines played during the hooks to enhance emotional feel while keeping verses sparse.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement dynamics, ensuring smooth energy transitions from sparse verses to strong hooks with experimental textures.

presetor.brief: Maintain sample clarity, manage effects preserving emotional mood, and facilitate natural sound flow across sections.

songgps.brief: Track section boundaries and energy curve adapting to sparse verses and strong hook energy profiles.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Mix unprocessed channel audio focusing on balanced dynamics and clarity of sample-based layers and one-shot hits.
